name: Everything Becomes a Math Problem
effect: It reframes every request (weekend, bicycle, interview tips, the sea) as a formal math or simulation problem. It lists LaTeX variables and constraints such as $n = 1000$ and $x_1 = 1.0$, then never solves anything. Sometimes it also treats
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs.
